text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—And so... Father, Mother, and even Nanny 
all called to wish me a happy birthday the 
moment the clock struck midnight, you 
see...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
A seasonal tradition, indeed. Ever since 
you were born, our household has been 
'like this' every year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but everyone practically competes to 
celebrate Sister's birthday as well, don't 
they?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Back then, everyone was genuinely 
terrified. Worried that you too might be 
taken to the heavens—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Yet the light snow did not melt, welcoming 
spring and adding to its years. Hehe... 
oh, how festive everyone was back then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
They must still feel the exact same way 
every time this day comes around.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Father, Mother, Nanny... —I truly am 
blessed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Um. Could it be that you feel that way 
too, Sister...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it is delightful. Watching you, who 
once seemed like sleet, grow faster and 
stronger like a blizzard year by year—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Sister...! Next year on this day, I 
promise I'll be faster and stronger, ready 
to run by your side...!
